name: latrunculina_A
notes: Macrolide from the sponge Latrunculia magnifica that binds the nucleotide cleft of monomeric actin, between subdomains 2 and 4, sequestering the monomer. Reference co-crystal: 1ESV (CCD LAR). Macrocycle: 12 active torsions, below the platform's default gate (GATE_MIN_TORSIONS=15 in runner.py). The ring is rigid, so the generic gate does not apply to it without an explicit override on the pair.
